description: One chat for all your coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, MiniMax and any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible API.
cmd.setApiKey: PolyMoly: Set API key for provider
cmd.setAdminKey: PolyMoly: Set usage admin key for provider
cmd.clearKeys: PolyMoly: Delete a provider’s saved keys
cfg.language: Language of the PolyMoly interface. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
cfg.providers: Custom providers. Each entry overrides a built-in provider with the same `id` (shallow merge). See the README for the schema.
cfg.mcpServers: MCP servers loaded by every CLI provider (Claude Code, Codex). Same schema as `.mcp.json`: `{ "name": { "command": "npx", "args": [] } }` or `{ "name": { "type": "http", "url": "https://…" } }`.
cfg.skillsDir: Folder with the shared skills (one subfolder with a `SKILL.md` per skill). Empty: `~/.polyagent/skills`. All providers use the same folder.
cfg.skillsDisabled: Names of installed skills that are switched off.
cfg.defaultProvider: Provider ID preselected in a new chat.
cfg.fallbackOrder: Order for switching models when a provider hits its limit mid-chat. Entries `provider` or `provider/model`, e.g. `["codex/gpt-5.6-sol", "anthropic-api/claude-opus-5-5"]`. Empty: an equivalent model from another provider is chosen automatically.
cfg.claudePermission: Default `--permission-mode` for the Claude CLI, used when a chat has no permission override of its own (composer → model menu → Permission). `acceptEdits` allows file edits without asking, `bypassPermissions` also allows shell commands without asking, `manual` asks on every action and `dontAsk` silently denies unapproved actions.
cfg.codexSandbox: Default `--sandbox` for `codex exec`, used when a chat has no permission override of its own (composer → model menu → Permission). `workspace-write` allows writing inside the workspace.
cfg.httpPermission: Local agent tools (files, shell, search) for API providers such as Z.ai GLM, OpenAI or Anthropic. `readonly` may only read, `edit` reads and edits files but runs no commands, `write` edits files without asking and confirms every shell command, `auto` runs everything without asking. Applies when a chat has no permission override of its own (composer → model menu → permissions).
cfg.httpPermEdit: Read and edit files, no commands
cfg.planParallel: Maximum number of independent plan tasks that run at once (1–8). This is also given to the planner so it can safely create small, independent low-tier tasks.
cfg.contextBudget: Maximum token budget for PolyMoly's local repository map (400–8000). The map contains paths, symbols and import links only; source is read on demand.
cfg.usageDays: Number of days the “Accounts & usage” view queries.
cfg.usageRefresh: Reload usage automatically every N minutes. 0 = off.
cfg.languageAuto: Follow the VS Code display language
